body.text: The Orthopaedic Center (TOC) is aleading orthopaedic care providerbased in Huntsville, Alabama. It isknown for its team of specializedphysicians and commitment topatient-centered care. With over 70providers across 13 locations, TOCreceives more than 60,000 patientcalls each month. In 2021, theorganization partnered withTransform9 to enhance patientcommunication and improveoperational efficiency.
